cases.title: The board console view of a Maven run, part-way through
cases.description: juneau-terminal's board view during a three-module Maven build: the progress bar at one of three modules and the running module's line under the row.

cases.title: The board console view of a finished Maven run
cases.description: juneau-terminal's board view after the build: one row with the full progress bar and the test count, and the final line.

cases.title: An agent pane beside a leader pane and a follower pane
cases.description: A tmux window split in two: on the left an AI agent waiting for its command; on the right, above, juneau-terminal's live view of that command (the leader pane) and, below it, the raw Maven output from tail -F on the full log (the follower pane).
